summary: Reading the wished uncursed mail scroll reaches the currently unported read.c seffect_mail branch. That function owns the missing junk-mail message and sets gk.known. The exercise(attrib.c:509) RNG annotation is the pre-switch Wisdom exercise in seffects, not the owner of the screen mismatch. The actionable scope is the complete seffect_mail function, including its stamped-scroll and default mail-reader branches.

source.branch: With MAIL_STRUCTURES enabled, seffects dispatches SCR_MAIL to seffect_mail. In this recording, #wizwish creates a mail scroll with spe == 1; its even o_id selects the junk-mail text. The whole function also handles spe == 2 and the default spe branch.
callers: read.c::seffects: sole direct caller; case SCR_MAIL calls seffect_mail(&sobj) at read.c:2203-2206.
read.c::doread: the real scroll-reading path calls seffects(scroll) at read.c:635.
dependencies: struct obj.spe: selects stamped-scroll (2), wished/bones mail (1), or the default branch.
struct obj.o_id: odd/even parity selects each spe == 1 or spe == 2 message variant.
gk.known: set to TRUE before the function handles any spe branch.
pline: emits the spe == 1 and spe == 2 messages and the MAIL-disabled fallback.
readmail(sobj): void external mail-reading call for the default spe branch when MAIL is defined; the function consumes no return value.

evidence: Frozen C source at 6d2c675aad59f170ec44980d6afce47f08ae7423: nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:2155-2189 contains the complete MAIL_STRUCTURES-guarded seffect_mail body. It reads sobj->spe and sobj->o_id, sets gk.known, then prints the spe == 1 or spe == 2 variant through pline; the default branch calls readmail(sobj) under MAIL or prints its fallback.

Frozen nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c:2194-2206 places exercise(A_WIS, TRUE) before the switch at lines 2199-2200, then dispatches SCR_MAIL to seffect_mail. read.c:635 shows doread passing the real scroll to seffects. Thus exercise owns the RNG annotation, while seffect_mail owns the missing message; the scoped port is the whole seffect_mail function.

The saved C recording challenges/cases/v15/wizard-reads-uncursed-mail-scroll.session.json has moves " #wizwish\nuncursed scroll of mail\nro "; its segment 0, step 37 screen says "This seems to be junk mail addressed to the finder of the Eye of Larn." This is seffect_mail's spe == 1, even-o_id branch (the source comment identifies spe == 1 mail as obtained by bones or wishing).
